Nigel Farage has announced his resignation as an MP, triggering a by-election in Clacton. This follows ongoing investigations into his parliamentary standards and financial declarations.

The Bright Side:
By standing for re-election, he is at least submitting his record to the immediate judgment of his voters.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is in the HOW (causal chain). The claim frames this as a proactive democratic act, while the reality is a reactive measure to mitigate political damage.

Social Physics Analysis:
Farage uses the pretext of 'democratic accountability' to avoid the consequences of the standards investigation. It is a projection of strength to hide a position of weakness.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. The move is designed to preserve his political capital.

The Unavoidable Truth: The standards investigation is the primary driver.

The Unavoidable Lie: This is a voluntary act of democratic transparency.
